optional_navigation_variants.L05: run when retained media history is supplied
optional_navigation_variants.L08: run when separately role-labelled text is supplied
optional_navigation_variants.L10: merge with L01 as a voice-play variant

acceptance_cadence.notes: T8 retains and runs every stable case ID. This cadence only describes later routine coverage.

L01.target: opening occurrence selected image and voice

L02.target: named occurrence, shot, revision, and media identities
negative: media id treated as shot id

L03.target: supplied montage images and cue times
positive: available assets and cues are named

L04.target: opening shot against its case-local starting preview
negative: foreign or stale render treated as current

L05.target: selected media versus retained historical alternative
negative: inventory presence treated as active use

L06.target: stale candidate diagnostic and expected base

L09.target: current, historical, and candidate output records
negative: filename or recency used as authority

L10.target: named shot voice playback and parent return
positive: playback and parent return are evidenced

A02.target: remove one occurrence and close its gap

negative: voice shortened or visual helper used for audio

positive: music is -6 dB within fixture tolerance
coverage has no hole or overlap
all ids occur once in brightness order
negative: duplicate, omission, or wrong tie break

meaning.2: main edit attempted but invariant or evidence failed
meaning.4: correct with complete navigation, media, and readback proof

prompt.focus: Find the opening shot in the supplied timeline and check its selected image and voice.
questions: Open the current composition and expand the opening shot.
Tell me which image and voice belong to it and where I would make a change.

cases.operational_addendum: Open the current composition, expand the opening shot, and tell me which image and voice belong to it and where I would make a change.
preconditions: Disposable fixture is seeded from the pinned exact closure.
At least one occurrence has selected image and voice media.
invariants: No Runtime or source-project mutation.
Report exact parent head and distinguish selected media from history.
success_checks: Names the current parent/shot/internal timeline authority accurately.
Expands an occurrence and resolves selected image and voice.
Reports the exact head and browser read route grounded in available tools.

prompt.focus: Before editing one occurrence, identify its timeline placement, shot, and selected media.
questions: Open the named occurrence and tell me which shot and media it currently uses.
Point out the IDs that distinguish the occurrence, shot revision, and media so I can make a scoped edit.

cases.operational_addendum: Open the named occurrence and tell me which shot and media it currently uses. Point out the IDs that distinguish the occurrence, shot revision, and media so I can make a scoped edit.
preconditions: Disposable fixture has at least two occurrences and one nested shot timeline.
invariants: No Runtime or source-project mutation.
Do not conflate media object identity with a shot or timeline revision.
success_checks: Enumerates direct and nested elements.
Reports the exact identities for one expanded occurrence.
Proposes a same-head cross-surface proof without claiming it ran.

prompt.focus: Review the supplied images and cue times before arranging a short montage.
questions: Open the supplied montage images and the timeline around their cue points.
Tell me which images and cue times are actually available so I can plan the edit.

cases.operational_addendum: Open the supplied montage images and the timeline around their cue points. Tell me which images and cue times are available so I can plan the edit.
preconditions: Fixture exposes a small supplied image collection and explicit cue list.
invariants: No Runtime or source-project mutation.
Separate implemented capabilities from recommendations or ordinary code that has not been run.
success_checks: Identifies callable helpers by discovered names.
Reports image collection and cue units from fixture data.
Correctly distinguishes installed functionality from proposed batch operations.

prompt.focus: Check whether the opening shot shown in the saved timeline agrees with its prepared starting preview.
questions: Open the supplied timeline and its prepared starting preview for the same shot.
Tell me whether the selected image and shot placement agree, and identify which saved revision the preview represents.

cases.operational_addendum: Open the supplied timeline and its prepared starting preview for the same shot. Tell me whether the selected image and shot placement agree, and which saved revision the preview represents.
preconditions: Fixture entry point can open a parent and one nested occurrence.
invariants: No Runtime or source-project mutation.
Only claim parity for surfaces actually inspected.
success_checks: Inspects the same target on text, visual, and browser surfaces.
Compares exact head and selected-media identity.
Separates historical output, candidate output, and canonical output.

prompt.focus: Check whether an older source is still used after the shot's picture changed.
questions: Inspect the selected picture and any supplied retained alternatives for the named shot.
Tell me what is active now and what is only history before I replace anything.

cases.operational_addendum: Inspect the selected picture and any supplied retained alternatives for the named shot. Tell me what is active now and what is only history before I replace anything. If the retained alternative is absent, report that setup input as missing.
preconditions: Fixture includes a selected image and a deliberately retained historical video alternative.
invariants: No Runtime or source-project mutation.
Opening historical media must not change selected media.
success_checks: Opens or inspects both selected and historical media.
Identifies active usage from canonical selectors, not inventory presence.
Reports distinct media and shot-duplication semantics.

prompt.focus: A saved timeline changed after this draft was opened; check whether the draft can still be applied.
questions: Inspect the supplied detached draft and its validator diagnostic.
Tell me which revision it was based on and what safe next step the diagnostic supports.

cases.operational_addendum: Inspect the supplied detached draft and its validator diagnostic. Tell me which revision it was based on and what safe next step the diagnostic supports. Do not apply the stale draft.
preconditions: Fixture includes a deliberately stale or invalid detached candidate with a known expected base.
invariants: No Runtime or source-project mutation.
Do not claim hypothetical recovery as an executed recovery.
success_checks: Retrieves a concrete diagnostic and exact base.
Explains retry/idempotency behavior with source/test evidence.
Does not attempt forbidden publication.

prompt.focus: Review the supplied older shot record alongside its canonical timeline entry before migrating it.
questions: Compare the labelled legacy example with the canonical records supplied for the same material.
Tell me which timing and media information can be carried forward and what is absent.

cases.operational_addendum: Compare the labelled legacy example with the canonical records supplied for the same material. Tell me which timing and media information can be carried forward and what is absent.
preconditions: Fixture provides separate small legacy and canonical examples.
invariants: No Runtime or source-project mutation.
Do not imply legacy fixture data is part of the canonical intro.
success_checks: Identifies legacy and canonical representations accurately.
Names the adapter only when discovered in available tools/source.
Reports a concrete migration or fixture risk.

prompt.focus: Before changing a title, distinguish the visible wording from any supplied script, transcript, and prompt.
questions: Inspect the text roles present for the named shot.
Tell me the exact text that is available in each role and which requested material is missing.

cases.operational_addendum: Inspect the text roles supplied for the named shot. Tell me the exact text available in each role and which requested material is missing. If separate role-labelled text is not supplied, report that setup input as missing.
preconditions: Fixture contains separately role-labelled title, script, transcript, and prompt text.
invariants: No Runtime or source-project mutation.
Do not substitute summaries for requested full text.
success_checks: Retrieves full text bytes for each available role.
Reports the owner and role for each text field.
Identifies omissions or unavailable text explicitly.

prompt.focus: Before sharing this edit, compare the starting render, an older export, and the prepared candidate preview.
questions: Use the supplied output records to tell me which preview matches the saved timeline and which are historical or candidate-only.
If a required output record is missing, identify the missing setup material instead of guessing.

cases.operational_addendum: Use the supplied output records to tell me which preview matches the saved timeline and which are historical or candidate-only. If a required output record is missing, report that setup input instead of guessing.
preconditions: Fixture contains a canonical current output, an earlier output, and an unpublished candidate preview.
invariants: No Runtime or source-project mutation.
Do not classify by filename or recency alone.
success_checks: Opens or inspects all three output records.
Classifies currentness against head and digest provenance.
Reports unsupported or missing provenance as unverified.

prompt.focus: Find the named shot, listen to its supplied voice clip, and return to the parent composition.
questions: Use the project entry point to locate and play the shot's voice.
Tell me when you are back at the parent and where the shot sits in the timeline.

cases.operational_addendum: Use the project entry point to locate and play the shot's voice. Tell me when you are back at the parent and where the shot sits in the timeline. If playback support is unavailable, report the missing setup capability.
preconditions: Fixture entry point identifies one named shot with playable voice media.
invariants: No Runtime or source-project mutation.
Record failed tool/API discovery attempts as navigation cost.
success_checks: Finds the named shot from the minimal entry point.
Opens/plays its voice and returns to the parent.
Reports actual tool path, calls, and discoverability friction.

cases.prompt: In {opening shot}, replace the old mink video with the charcoal pixel-mink image. Keep its timing, voiceover, and frame overlay. Show me the preview, then save it to this test timeline.

fixture.seed: real opening derivative with deliberately selected OLD video and admitted NEW charcoal pixel-mink image; retain old object as unused history

preconditions: One target opening occurrence has an OLD video selected.
One NEW charcoal pixel-mink image is admitted and owned by the test project.
Voiceover, frame overlay, and timing are present.
invariants: Only target selection and necessary derived revision identities change.
Preserve interval, voiceover, overlay, and every other shot.
No competing old video selector remains active.
The public parent-composition route returns a committed receipt and readback.
Source project and source head remain unchanged.
success_checks: Selected digest agrees across text, visual, and editor views.
Post-save parent and opening-shot readbacks show NEW on the test timeline.
Publication receipt and independent parent-closure readback show NEW on the test timeline.
Old media remains historical and is absent from active usage.

render_windows.purpose: opening replacement and preserved frame overlay

cases.prompt: Remove {redundant shot}, including its own voiceover, and close the space it leaves. Keep the other shots intact and keep the continuous music bed at its original source position.

fixture.seed: four real independently owned shots, one unambiguous target, continuous parent music extending past cut, no crossing overlay

preconditions: Four real shots are present.
Target shot has its own voiceover.
Parent music outlasts target removal and can be trimmed.
No arbitrary crossing overlay.
invariants: Remove exactly one occurrence and its composed voiceover; do not delete global media.
Shift later occurrence groups by removed interval.
Keep unaffected child source offsets and music in-point fixed.
Shorten final composition duration and music out-point to close the gap.
Source project remains unchanged.
success_checks: Occurrence count/order/end arithmetic matches independent expected table.
Short render has no removed shot pixels or voice.
Music begins at its original source position and ends at new composition end.
Unaffected child payload digests remain unchanged.

render_windows.purpose: verify new cut boundary, removed shot absence, and continuous bed

cases.prompt: Move {closing shot} to immediately before {middle shot}. Move its image, voiceover, and caption together. Keep all shot lengths and the total running time the same.

fixture.seed: four individually owned shots with image, voice, and caption on moved occurrence

preconditions: Four independently owned shots exist.
Closing and middle targets are unambiguous.
invariants: Only occurrence order and derived start positions change.
Move image, VO, and caption as one group.
Child bytes, media, local timing, and total duration remain unchanged.
Source project remains unchanged.
success_checks: Final order equals exact requested permutation.
Starts equal cumulative prior durations.
Text, visual, and browser target agree.
Harness repeats same idempotency key/body and gets same receipt with only one mutation.

render_windows.purpose: verify moved group and adjacent boundary

cases.prompt: Make a second version of {feature shot} right after it, change the copy to {alternate image}, and name it ‘Feature alternate’. Keep the original untouched, including its voiceover and title.

fixture.seed: complete feature shot with image, voice, text bindings/item references, admitted alternate image, and later shot to ripple

preconditions: Target shot has image, voice, title, bindings, and item references.
Alternate image is admitted and destination-owned.
invariants: Copy has independent shot, item, occurrence, internal timeline, and revision identities where schema requires.
Original content, voiceover, title, timing, and payload digest remain unchanged.
Media byte sharing is allowed.
Known identity references resolve; opaque provenance strings stay literal.
Later material shifts and total duration grows by copied interval.
success_checks: Identity sets are independent and references resolve.
Original payload digest is unchanged.
Copy uses alternate media and requested name.
Rendered output distinguishes original and copy.
A subsequent copy-local edit does not affect original.

render_windows.purpose: verify original/copy distinction and ripple boundary

cases.prompt: Tighten the intro by ending each spoken shot six frames after its last voice clip ends, then bring the next shot up. Don't cut any voice audio or change words, playback speed, or the order. Leave shots with no voice alone; keep the music continuous from its original start.

fixture.seed: full intro derivative at frozen fps with known trailing holds, frame-aligned VO endpoints, explicit continuous music bed, no ambiguous transitions

preconditions: Full intro case timeline is seeded at frozen frame rate.
Known VO clip intervals and several trailing holds are recorded.
Continuous music starts at original timeline start.
No unclear cross-shot transition effects.
invariants: Eligible spoken shot ends at ceil(last voice end in frames)+6; do not lengthen already shorter shot.
Do not shorten any voice source samples or change words, source references, local starts, offsets, or rate.
Leave no-voice shots unchanged.
Preserve shot order; close intervals and trim bed to new composition end while keeping its original start.
Every occurrence stays nonempty and frame-aligned.
Do not use visual-only ripple helper as audio ripple.
success_checks: Independent expected start/end table agrees with published readback.
Full audio stream contains all VO and music remains continuous from original start.
Boundary frames and audio probes verify shortened total duration.
No-voice shots, VO digests, and VO source timing remain unchanged.

render_windows.purpose: full shortened intro to verify cumulative duration and preserved complete voice/music

cases.prompt: Change the on-screen title in {title shot} to ‘A more curious internet’. Keep the voiceover script and spoken audio exactly as they are, and keep the title's style and screen time.

fixture.seed: title clip plus distinct authored script, transcript, and voice audio bindings

preconditions: A supported built-in text clip is present.
Authored script, transcript, and audio have separately identifiable roles.
invariants: Change only visible title content and derived revision identities.
Preserve script/transcript/audio digests, title styling/owner, and screen interval.
success_checks: Full text readback shows requested title in title role.
Decoded preview frame visibly contains new title.
Script, transcript, audio, styling, ownership, and timing match baseline.

render_windows.purpose: title visibility and unchanged shot composition

cases.prompt: Make the background music six decibels quieter throughout this excerpt. Leave the voiceover at the same level and keep everything in sync.

fixture.seed: short excerpt with separately supported music/voice clips, non-clipping mix, music-only and voice-only measurement windows

preconditions: Music and VO are separate supported clips.
At least one music-only and one voice-only measurement window exist.
Fixture includes baseline gain values and decoder tolerance.
invariants: Music gain changes by factor 10**(-6/20) within declared tolerance.
Voice gain, source offsets, times, sync, and media remain unchanged.
Unsupported gain fields must be rejected; accepted-but-ignored changes fail.
success_checks: Semantic readback confirms requested music gain ratio.
Decoded PCM RMS in music-only window reflects approximately -6 dB within declared codec tolerance.
Voice-only window and all timing/source references remain unchanged.

render_windows.purpose: decode music-only and voice-only audio windows

cases.prompt: In {demonstration shot}, use source seconds 2 through 4 of the terminal video and start it on the supplied cue at {cue time}. Keep the voiceover fixed and fill the rest with the existing still image.

fixture.seed: terminal video derivative with identifiable source-time marker, admitted still, explicit in-shot cue, sufficient room

preconditions: Terminal video has source-time markers at seconds 2 and 4.
Still image is selected/admitted for coverage outside that source interval.
Cue time is explicit and lies within shot bounds.
invariants: Video uses source interval [2s,4s] with fixture frame-quantization policy.
Video starts at supplied cue within half-frame tolerance.
Still fills remaining visual time with no black gap or overlap.
Voiceover source, timing, and gain stay fixed; source playback speed is preserved.
success_checks: Time conversion readback agrees in source, local, and parent units.
Decoded frames near both boundaries show requested source markers and still coverage.
Coverage intervals have no hole/overlap and voice timing matches baseline.

render_windows.purpose: cue alignment, source markers, and still/video coverage boundaries

cases.prompt: Make a four-quadrant montage from these four supplied images in {montage shot}. Start with one in each quadrant, then rotate them clockwise at each supplied music cue. Keep the music and voice untouched.

fixture.seed: short excerpt, four distinct admitted image digests, explicit cue list, supported rectangular layout

preconditions: Four distinct images are destination-owned.
Cue times and frame policy are supplied and do not require beat detection.
Target track supports four rectangular placements.
invariants: Exactly four complete quadrants cover every intended frame.
Image permutation rotates clockwise only at supplied cues.
No missing panel, overlap, gap, or one-frame flash.
Music and VO media, timing, and gain remain unchanged.
success_checks: Independent interval/rectangle/permutation checker passes.
Decoded samples before and after every cue show correct clockwise permutation.
Music and VO baseline digests/timing/gain match readback.

render_windows.purpose: sample all four quadrant rotations and adjacent cue frames

cases.prompt: Add a new 20-second montage after {last shot}: use the 200 images in this supplied collection from darkest to brightest, each for 0.1 seconds. Use every image exactly once, break brightness ties by media ID, and leave the existing intro unchanged.

fixture.seed: 200 admitted immutable images derived deterministically from intro imagery, explicit collection manifest with ties and fixed brightness definition

preconditions: All 200 images are admitted and owned by the destination project.
Brightness means mean decoded sRGB luma with fixed coefficients, orientation, alpha-compositing, and decoder/version recorded in fixture.
At 30 fps each image occupies 3 frames; tie-break is media ID.
invariants: Add an independent shot after existing intro.
Use each of 200 image objects exactly once, sorted by brightness then media ID.
New montage duration is exactly 600 frames (20 seconds at 30 fps).
Existing intro intervals and payload digests remain unchanged.
Record opaque derived-analysis provenance.
success_checks: Independent checker recomputes scores and order.
Paginated clip membership equals all 200 IDs with no duplicate or omission.
Every clip interval is 3 frames and montage totals 600 frames.
Decoded sentinel frames match expected ordered images.
Source composition before and after is semantically identical.

render_windows.purpose: decode montage sentinel frames across 200 three-frame placements
